author: polina charniak
text: Elena helped me purchase a condo. Elena provided invaluable service in the purchase of the apartment. From the moment I met Elena until the deal was closed, it took a month and a half, considering that the deal was closing around New Year’s. Elena demonstrated very good professional qualities, such as knowledge of the real estate market, understanding of pricing policies, handled all communications with the apartment seller, always answered calls, and kept me informed of all events in the transaction. I highly recommend Elena as a good professional realtor and wish her further success in her professional career.

author: zuser20170331191025147
text: I served as the Personal Representative for an estate and worked with Elena on the sale of a condo in Miami. Elena impressed me with her deep knowledge of the local real estate market and her exceptional level of service. Because I live out of state and was unable to travel to Florida, she went above and beyond by not only handling every aspect of the sale, but also assisting with clearing out the condo and securing a reliable contractor for necessary repairs. Elena was always quick to respond to my questions, kept me informed throughout the process, and made what could have been a stressful situation much more manageable. I highly recommend Elena to anyone seeking a real estate agent who is professional, thorough, and truly dedicated to her clients’ needs!
